segments.text:
V. 1.
He paſſed thro' Jericho—So that Zaccheus muſt have lived near the End of the Town; the Tree was in the Town itſelf. And he was rich—Theſe Words ſeem to refer to the Diſcourſe in the laſt Chapter, ver. 24—27, particularly to ver. 27. Zuccheus is a Proof, that it is poſſible, by the Power of GOD, for even a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.
